readingDispositions.qualification: Exact written boundary: 凪 writes な, ぐ remains outside. Teach が-marked wind/sea subject and modern 凪ぎます/凪がない/凪いで/凪いだ with kana. proposedDirectExclusions.reason: 穏やか explicitly describes calm sea in its current article; 静か has a full dictionary calm/peaceful sense beyond its short quiet/silent label. These can be reasonable descriptions of the displayed sea-calm noun even though syntax differs; conservative direct guards, not universal synonyms.

静まる subside/die-down and 止む cease/let-up overlap directly for wind; 落ち着く has a separate situation-abating/die-down sense. 穏やか/静か also give calm-state choices usable as loose weather glosses despite change/state differences. Guard each displayed pair directly; do not rely on old exclusions between these words.

proposedQuiz.notExcluded: 冷静's composure/presence-of-mind sense is not sea calm. The noun凪 and verb凪ぐ have deliberately state/change-specific labels and ordinary distinct meanings; sharing a character or weather topic alone does not establish a direct exclusion. Final independent review may refine these proposals.
